COLL249_GENERALIZED_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) {f : Polynomial ℤ},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ (J : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)) (C : ℕ),
      (∀ W ∈ Collision249RevisedMain.boxFamily r B,
          ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree, |(Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ ↑C) →
        ↑(2 * C + 1) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < (↑B + 1) ^ ∏ᶠ (j : σ), (r j + 1) →
          ∃ W' ∈ Collision249RevisedMain.boxFamily r B,
            ∃ W'' ∈ Collision249RevisedMain.boxFamily r B,
              W' ≠ W'' ∧ ∀ j ∈ J, Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W') %ₘ f = Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f
